product_metadata.title: Donut Fresh Container - by Touch Up Cup - 6 Fresh Donut Keeper, Holder & Airtight Kitchen & Pantry Organization and Storage. Keeps donuts fresh for longer - As Seen on Shark Tank
features: AIRTIGHT FRESHNESS: Air-tight and water-proof design to keep donuts as fresh as the day you bought them or made them. Keep up to 6 donuts fresh and delicious for days!
PREVENT STALE DONUTS: Stop throwing out your money & stale donuts, and start keeping them fresh for several days. Save money & save your donuts!
BPA FREE QUALITY : Made from BPA-Free materials that ensure containers to be safe & eco-friendly lockable storage.
MICROWAVE & DISHWASHER SAFE: Long lasting, durable, and strong high quality materials guarantee you to microwave, freeze, and even dishwash at your convenience.
REDUCE PLASTIC BAGS & REUSE: Earth-friendly design to prevent the use of hazardous plastic bags that pollute our Earth - Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle at your local deli or grocery store today!
description: The Donut Fresh ergonomic container solves the problem of donuts becoming stale. The innovative airtight design allows for 6 donuts to be stored for days! This environmentally friendly product eliminates plastic storage bags in our landfills.
